words: The Performance chart in DashboardPerformance.tsx no longer waits for a MEASURED window. A new exported function, chartRows, builds one row per served day of the history: its linked value inside the window, and null outside the window or on a day with no return. It also adds one valueless gap row for each unreported trading day that lies strictly inside the history. The single Area keeps connectNulls false, so each no-return day and each gap row breaks the line, and an isolated measured day is drawn as a dot. The brush maps its indexes through the rows back to served days and never reads the served dates directly. A one-sentence note above the chart counts the no-return days the curve breaks at, and the tooltip names a gap row's day. The headline figure, the notes, the window status and performanceView are unchanged. The new test file pins chartRows on variants of the three existing series fixtures, with no fixture added. Run at the candidate head: AC1 and AC2 pass with the issuer checker; the irpt-dashbd tests pass, 185 of 185; the typecheck and the production build pass by hand. AC3 is FAIL as written: two dsgn-irptv1 wire-regeneration tests fail on this box, which sets core.autocrlf, and neither test reads a file this cell changed; the base head was not run. NOT PROVEN: no browser walk, no live render of the Cottonwood page, and nothing on DEV or PROD.
